scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, providing hospitalization cover to economically vulnerable families.
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization, cashless and paperless at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Families identified per SECC deprivation/occupational criteria
Eligibility can be checked on the PM-JAY portal by ration/Aadhaar details
application_steps: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or via CSC
Avail cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
